findings.issue: Task 11 and Task 12 both declare `wave: 7` and `depends_on: ["10"]`, so a wave runner executes them in parallel — but Task 11 is written as if Task 12 has not started. Concrete collisions: (a) Task 11 AC «Продуктовый код не изменён» and Verification Step 8 `git status` — «изменения только в отчёте и decisions log» — will see Task 12's concurrent edits to docs/technical.md, CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.ru.md and produce a false negative or a false positive; (b) Details says «Задача 12 (документация) идёт после и в объём приёмки не входит», which contradicts the shared wave; (c) both tasks append to the same file 0011-feat-group-customization-decisions.md concurrently — lost-update risk. Tech-spec puts both under a single «Final Wave», so the tech-spec has the same ambiguity.
findings.fix: Pick one: (1) add "11" to Task 12's `depends_on` and move Task 12 to `wave: 8`; or (2) keep them parallel but scope Task 11's git check to `git status -- src/ tests/` (product code only), drop the «Задача 12 идёт после» sentence, and give each task its own decisions-log append step ordered by the orchestrator. Mirror the choice in the tech-spec Implementation Tasks section.

findings.issue: Task 11 step 3 makes `node -v` ≥ 22.12 a hard stop («Несоответствие — critical: дальше идти нельзя»). Verified on the current machine: `node -v` → v18.19.1, there is no `.nvmrc` and no `engines` field in package.json, and `npx vitest run` already fails with `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` while loading the vite config (vitest ^4.0.18 requires Node 20.19+/22.12+). Task 1 is scoped to *pin* the version and stop the pipeline, not to perform the upgrade — so nothing in tasks 1–12 makes this precondition true. As written, Task 11 (and in fact the whole pipeline from Task 1 onward) cannot complete in this environment.
findings.fix: No edit to the task text is required, but the orchestrator must upgrade the runtime to Node ≥ 22.12 before wave 0 starts. Surface this as an explicit pipeline precondition rather than discovering it at wave 7. Optionally add a note in Task 11 Details that the runtime check is expected to have been satisfied outside the feature pipeline.

findings.issue: Details / CHANGELOG claims: «две последние по времени записи (v6 и v7) не добавляли строку в `### Changed`, а упоминали версию прямо внутри записи `Added` («Data schema migrated to version 7»)». Only ONE such entry exists. Verified mapping from src/data/migration.ts: v3 = notes/notesCollapsed, v4 = hiddenGroups, v5 = fullWidth, v6 = cardLayout, v7 = notesHidden. In CHANGELOG.md the v7 feature («Notes Visibility … Data schema migrated to version 7») is the only inline-version entry; the v6 bump (cardLayout / multi-column card layout, feature 0008) has NO CHANGELOG entry at all — neither in `### Added` nor in `### Changed`. The `### Changed` block (lines 24–26, correctly cited) covers versions 3/4/5 only. Same in CHANGELOG.ru.md.
findings.fix: Rewrite the precedent as «последняя по времени запись (v7, Notes Visibility) упоминает версию прямо внутри записи Added — следовать ей». Additionally instruct the executor to record the missing v6 / multi-column-layout CHANGELOG entry as documentation drift in the decisions log (it is outside the editable blocks, so it should be reported, not silently fixed).

findings.issue: The reload simulation via `window.__test.resetData(snapshot)` has side effects the task does not mention: tests/harness/main.ts:111 resets `uiStore` to `{ activeBoardId: data.boards[0]?.id, toasts: [] }`, line 100 forces `settings.language = 'en'`, and lines 103–105 back-fill `hiddenGroups: []` on every board. Any scenario that «reloads» while a non-first board is active silently lands back on board A. Сц.1 is single-board so it is safe today, but the Сц.9 (two boards) + persistence combination would break, and there is no warning in Edge cases.
findings.fix: Add to Edge cases: «resetData сбрасывает активную доску на boards[0] — после симуляции перезагрузки на многодосочном сценарии переключись на нужную доску через `page.selectOption('.tm-board-header__select', boardId)` перед проверками».

findings.issue: Сц.5 DOM-probe instruction says «перед сменой порядка пометить тела групп (`[data-group-id]`)». Verified in src/ui/CollapsibleGroup.svelte:61-68: the body carrying `data-group-id` lives inside `{#if !collapsed}`, so for `backlog`/`completed` it does not exist until `expandGroup` runs, and it is destroyed/recreated on every collapse toggle — a probe placed before expanding would be absent for reasons unrelated to reordering, and the check would fail spuriously (or be skipped silently if the locator resolves to zero elements).
findings.fix: State explicitly: expand the collapsible group first, then set the probe on all `[data-group-id]` bodies, and do not toggle collapse between probing and checking. Alternatively probe the wrapper `[data-group-container]`, which is the node Decision 1 actually promises to preserve.

findings.issue: Сц.5 offers `completed` as an alternative to `backlog` for the collapsible pair. Verified in src/ui/BoardLayout.svelte: CollapsibleGroup for `completed` is rendered with `onAdd={null}`, so there is no add button and `createTask(page, 'completed', …)` from helpers.ts (which clicks `.tm-collapsible-group__add`) cannot work there. Also, dragging into/out of `completed` fires the status transitions in src/logic/statusTransitions.ts (sets/clears `completedAt`, flips status), adding noise to a scenario whose subject is drag survival.
findings.fix: Recommend `backlog` explicitly as the collapsible group for Сц.5 and note that tasks cannot be created directly in `completed` (no add button), so `completed` may only be a drag target, never the source of a freshly created card.

findings.issue: The task forbids locating groups by displayed name, then relies on `expandGroup` from helpers.ts. In the current (pre-Task-9) edition, helpers.ts:99-107 locates the collapsible header by English label text (`COLLAPSIBLE_GROUP_LABELS`, `.filter({ hasText: label })`). In Сц.1 and Сц.5 the group under test is renamed before `expandGroup` is called, so if Task 9 leaves any label-based lookup in place the helper breaks at runtime. The task only says «читай файл в актуальном виде», which is not a check.
findings.fix: Add an explicit first step: verify that `expandGroup` (and every other helper used after a rename) no longer matches on displayed text; if it still does, stop and report to the orchestrator rather than working around it locally.
